summary: Master advanced criminal intelligence analysis, link charting, and information management. 10-day expert-led course for analysts and investigators.
lede: Criminal intelligence analysis helps intelligence, investigative, and security professionals turn scattered information into useful assessments. Participants learn to manage information integrity, develop link analyses and target profiles, and use geographic and digital information to identify patterns. The training also covers applying the SARA model and communicating findings through clear intelligence reports and briefings.
audienceIntro: This program is tailored for experienced professionals operating within the intelligence, law enforcement, and corporate security sectors who require advanced analytical capabilities.
modules: Intelligence Foundations and the National Intelligence Model
Information Management and Data Integrity Systems
Tactical Analytical Techniques and Link Analysis
Crime Mapping and Geographic Information Systems
Open Source Intelligence and Digital Footprints
Predictive Analytics and AI in Intelligence
prerequisites: Participants should have at least 2-3 years of experience in an analytical, investigative, or information management role. Familiarity with basic spreadsheet software (Excel) is required. Prior exposure to the Intelligence Cycle or basic crime analysis concepts is highly recommended to maximize the value of the advanced modules.
